title: LEGION-186: a resumed root is held to the same-agent rule in the wired daemon; the worker shim refuses a providers key that shadows a pod variable
baseline: main 8fce288ef3273c99267b89c90f4faedef63a23a3 (fork point; main@origin has since moved to 3051519d — a pi-envoy release — and the branch was not rebased, per the CONFLICTING-only rule)

commits.message: fix(daemon): forward every boot-token mint argument so a resumed root is held to the same-agent rule (LEGION-186)
fix(worker-shim): refuse a providers key that would shadow a variable of the pod's environment (LEGION-186)
docs: the worker shim refuses a providers key that shadows a pod variable (LEGION-186)

proof.criterion: Acceptance 1: a resumed root whose /process/started arrives from a different session is refused 409 by the wired daemon, claim untouched; the recorded session registers 200 (Acceptance 2's behavioural pin).
proof.surface: The full-daemon harness: startDaemon over the fake tmux runtime with the real index.ts ProcessManager wiring and the real /legion/v1/process/started route (packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/index.test.ts), plus the planner's throwaway repro of the reviewer's reproduction re-run against the fixed workspace.
proof.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && bun test packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/index.test.ts -t "same-agent rule through the wired daemon"; and bun test /tmp/legion-186-plan/root-same-agent-wiring.main.test.ts
proof.observed: 1 pass, 10 expect() calls: boot logged `[legion] resurrecting WIDGETS-42 by resuming OMP session <stateDir>/root-original.jsonl`, the one launch carried `--resume=<that file>`, tree active; POST /process/started with rootSessionId ses_FRESH_AGENT → HTTP 409 {"error":"Worker respawn must resume the same agent session"}, state.roles[architect] still {issue, role: architect, sessionId: ses_root_original, generation: 1}, tree locator unchanged; the same POST with ses_root_original → HTTP 200 and the claim carries agentId root-agent. The repro file: `REPRO /process/started -> 409 {"error":"Worker respawn must resume the same agent session"}`, `REPRO architect claim after: {…"sessionId":"ses_root_original"…}`, 1 pass.
proof.negativeControl: The same new test on the unchanged wiring (main 8fce288e; the red run before commit 5a65fbdb): `expect(refused.status).toBe(409)` — Expected: 409, Received: 200 (0 pass, 1 fail, 5 expect() calls); the planner's pre-fix repro at that baseline recorded HTTP 200 and the architect claim rewritten to sessionId ses_FRESH_AGENT.

proof.criterion: Acceptance 3: the worker shim refuses to start — exit non-zero, message naming the key and its file path, Oh My Pi never spawned — when a providers-Secret key is already a variable of its environment; a NAME_FILE-pointed key is still skipped; a non-colliding key is still exported.
proof.surface: The real CLI as a real process with a real environment: `bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts worker-shim --connect …` (the workspace's build of the entry the pod runs) with OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql in the process environment and a real temp providers directory; the three unit tests (`-t runWorkerShim`, fake connect + fake spawn) are the regression lock.
proof.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && d=$(mktemp -d) && printf file > "$d/OMP_SESSION_STORAGE" && printf tok-1 > "$d/boot" && OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts worker-shim --connect tcp://127.0.0.1:1 --boot-token-file "$d/boot" --provider-env-dir "$d" -- sh -c "touch $d/spawned"; echo exit=$?; test -e "$d/spawned" && echo SPAWNED || echo not-spawned
proof.observed: stderr: `legion worker-shim: --provider-env-dir key OMP_SESSION_STORAGE (/tmp/tmp.kfwWXd4UK2/OMP_SESSION_STORAGE) is already a variable of this pod's environment; exporting it would silently override that value — rename or remove the providers-Secret key`; exit=1 at once (0.2 s); no `[worker-shim] daemon stream … unavailable` line, so no dial; `not-spawned`. Unit side: `bun test packages/daemon/src/cli/__tests__/worker-shim.test.ts` 35 pass (refuse: CliError naming key and path, 0 dials, 0 spawns; skip: DISPATCH_TOKEN with DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE set not exported, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exported, exit 0; export: non-colliding key reaches the fake spawn's env beside OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql, exit 0; the readProviderEnvDir skip test pins the pointer winning over a same-named variable).
proof.negativeControl: The same command with the file renamed LEGION_TEST_PROVIDER_KEY (confirmed unset with printenv) under `timeout 3` → the shim passes resolution and dials: `[worker-shim] daemon stream 127.0.0.1:1 unavailable (Failed to connect); retrying in 200ms` … 400 … 800 … 1600 ms, exit=124, not-spawned — the pre-fix path for a non-colliding key. Also: renaming it ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was refused as well because that variable is set in the pane the proof ran in — the rule covers every variable of the environment, not the two storage names. Before the fix (main 8fce288e, the planner's preFixReproduction.finding2) the colliding key was accepted silently: dial lines, exit=124.

testsRun: bun test packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/index.test.ts -t "same-agent rule through the wired daemon" — red on main (Received: 200), green after commit 5a65fbdb

bun test packages/daemon/src/cli/__tests__/worker-shim.test.ts -t "runWorkerShim|readProviderEnvDir" — refuse red (`runWorkerShim resolved instead of refusing`, 6 ms; skip, export and readProviderEnvDir green) before the refusal, all green after
cd packages/daemon && bunx tsc --noEmit — exit 0; bunx biome check src/ — 172 files, no fixes
jj diff --from 8fce288e --to @ --summary — lists neither packages/contracts/src/legion-daemon-api.ts nor packages/pi-envoy/package.json (Acceptance 6)
deviations: The runWorkerShim test helper's fake dial acks itself on the next turn (setImmediate → hello_ack) instead of the tests hand-driving the ack after a waitFor: with the plan's shape the refuse test went red by a 5 s timeout (the shim dialed and waited on a daemon that never answered), so a regression would surface as a timeout rather than a named failure. With the self-acking dial a run that wrongly gets past resolution spawns, exits 0, and fails at `runWorkerShim resolved instead of refusing` in 6 ms; the skip and export tests then await the exit code directly and also assert exactly one dial. What is asserted is unchanged.

docs/kubernetes.md's shim export paragraph (the `Two things keep secrets out of kubectl get pod -o yaml` paragraph) gained one short clause pointing at the providers Secret section, per the architect's assignment; the plan edited only the providers Secret sentence.
The issue bookmark was set on @- with --allow-backwards: jj's split left the bookmark on the empty working copy, which jj refuses to push undescribed.
trickyParts: A callback naming fewer parameters than its target is legal TypeScript, so main's two-parameter wrapper compiled silently while dropping spawnTree's expectedSessionId; only a rest-args spread ties the dep's and the API's signatures together (the planner's typeShapeCheck).

The collision check must run after the NAME_FILE pointer skip: a file-pointed key is never exported, so there is nothing to shadow, and the production pod (DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE, ENVOY_TOKEN_FILE set) must never be refused for it.
The refusal covers an empty variable too (`!== undefined`): the pod sets GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_HOST to "" on purpose.
